I thought I'd let you know about new updates we just shipped at Poof.

Studio app

Process images and test the full API from your browser without writing a line of code. Drag in an image, set every parameter and see the result with its metadata. A history panel keeps your recent runs with previews and downloads. You can process many images at once and download results to your computer with one click.
Try it now

Output options


We added a slew of new options for processing output images. You can now size the returned image directly in the request. Pass width and/or height to scale the result, and fit to control how the image is fitted into the box. We also improved per-axis padding . New padding parameter accepts a horizontal and vertical value, e.g. padding=10%,7.5%. The single-value form still works and applies to both axes.
See documentation
